test_set.english: The evaluator and the thing evaluated share their state, so passing certifies only self-agreement rather than correctness.
A situation in which the checker is not independent of what it checks, because both are produced by the same party or process, so a pass proves nothing about correctness.
The judge of a result is the same agent, model, or process that produced the result, meaning the verdict cannot count as an independent check.
A marker for a verification whose grader and graded output are under common control, so agreement between them is expected by construction and carries no evidential weight.

Glosses frozen before any encoding was loaded.
